description.zh: 按照资源的产品类型过滤，不填代表所有类型。
description.en: Filters by the product type of the resource. If this parameter is not specified, all types are queried.

description.zh: 资源所有者 ID 列表，在跨账号场景使用，置空时默认获取当前账号的数据
description.en: The list of resource owner IDs. This parameter is used in cross-account scenarios. If this parameter is left empty, data of the current account is returned by default.

description.zh: 按照资源所在地域过滤，不填代表所有地域。
description.en: Filters by the region where the resource resides. If this parameter is not specified, all regions are queried.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun bdrc describe-products --resource-category-id rc-000000123 --resource-region-id cn-shanghai --product-type oss --resource-owner-ids 1230007890 --region cn-hangzhou
